podcast.body: This song, from the "Phantom Power" album, was the Juno single of the year in 2000. Gord Downie initially claimed it was about a stressed-out city cop who loved the Kawartha Lakes region, but later revealed the true reason for the title was his inability to find a word that rhymed with "constellations." "But the only reason the song is called Bob Cajun and thereby setting it in Ontario cottage country is because Gord couldn't think of another word that rhymed with constellations."
